title: Uwell Caliburn G5 Lite KOKO 35W Pod Kit
description:
The
Uwell Caliburn G5 Lite KOKO 35W Pod Kit
combines the signature square KOKO design with a 1600mAh battery, PRO-FOCS 4.0 technology, and stepless airflow control from MTL to RDL. Features a frosted shell finish and KOKO breathing light.
Product Type:
Open Pod System (Refillable)
Battery:
1600mAh
Wattage:
Up to 35W
Charging:
USB Type-C
Activation:
Draw-Activated
E-Liquid Capacity:
3mL
Coil Resistance:
Integrated Mesh
Airflow:
Stepless Adjustable (MTL to RDL)
Display:
KOKO Breathing Light (Battery Indicator)
Pod Compatibility:
Caliburn GPP Pods (0.4Ω, 0.6Ω, 0.9Ω, 1.2Ω), Caliburn G3 Pods
Brand:
Uwell
E-liquid sold separately. Fill with your choice of salt nic or freebase e-liquid.
Available options: Knight Black, Starry Gray.
